products.name: Discs, tapes, solid-state non-volatile storage devices, smart cards and other media for the recording of sound or of other phenomena, whether or not recorded, including matrices and masters for the production of discs, excluding products of Chapter 37

Electrical parts of machinery or apparatus; not specified or elsewhere included in this chapter

Typewriter, similar ribbons, inked, otherwise prepared for giving impressions, whether or not on spools or in cartridges; ink pads, whether or not inked, with or without boxes
Polymers of vinyl acetate or of other vinyl esters, in primary forms; other vinyl polymers in primary forms
